propositions: The Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on every run with a JQL parse error: 'project = LEG AND status != Done' is rejected because project LEG does not exist in live Jira.

The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with a rehearsal fixture mapping containing nonexistent keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO instead of the canonical single-project state with empty projects dict.

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out issues a JQL query for every key in projects.json; when projects.json contains nonexistent keys, the first query fails and aborts the entire reconciliation pass.

The corrupted .bridge_state/projects.json state landed via ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch using the test-fixture git identity, violating the concurrency contract that all store mutations must use unified write locks and auto-commit/publish.

Restoration of .bridge_state/projects.json to the canonical state {version: 1, legacy_default: REB, projects: {}} and a live rebar bridge preview run both succeed without JQL parse errors, confirming the fix.
